prompt:
We're kicking off a new embedded firmware project for our SmartHome Hub v2 device (STM32F4-based, 512KB flash, 128KB RAM, WiFi + BLE modules). The team has been trying to track this project but the attempts so far (you'll find some scattered files in the workspace) are incomplete and disorganized.

Please do the following three things:

1. Set up a proper, well-organized project tracking system for this firmware project. Name the project 'smarthome-hub'. The feature list should be thorough and granular — break every aspect of the firmware into small, independently-trackable work items covering initialization, WiFi stack, BLE, OTA updates, GPIO, sensor drivers, power management, error handling, documentation, and testing infrastructure.

2. Execute the first development session: complete the single highest-priority feature that hasn't been started yet, implement it (you can create a stub/skeleton implementation in src/), verify it works, and record the session outcome properly.

3. After the session, output a project status summary so we can see how many features are done vs. remaining, grouped by priority.
